definitions.network_dispersion: Difference between implied GCC prices across connected pools.
definitions.corrective_activity: Transactions associated with cross-pool price compression in the historical sample; not proof of intent or automation.
definitions.effective_scarcity: GCC held at an address considered economically inaccessible; not a reduction in totalSupply.
definitions.lp_vs_hodl: Historical hypothetical difference between providing liquidity and holding the same starting assets.
definitions.connected_asset_transmission: Historical return association between connected quote assets and the GCC network reference; not causality or permanence.
